title: Gate state names the run that produced it
description:
Record, on each issue's gate state, the id of the latest run recorded for that gate, so the latest run is addressed from the issue record instead of being found by scanning runs.

## Background

`GateState` (`crates/jit/src/domain/types.rs:400-408`) holds a status, an actor and a timestamp, but not the run that produced it. Every reader that needs an issue's latest run of a gate therefore lists runs and selects one. The only conversion from a recorded run to a gate state is `gate_state_from_run` (`commands/gate_check.rs:225-246`), called by gate evaluation (`gate_check.rs:969`, `:1521`) and by lifecycle prechecks (`commands/mod.rs:2950`). A manual gate write replaces the state wholesale (`commands/mod.rs:1719-1723`), and a newly required gate is seeded at `commands/mod.rs:1647`.

`GateState` is built by struct literal in `domain/types.rs` tests (`:2296-2573`), `domain/queries.rs:871`, `output.rs:3075`, `validation/graph.rs:3180`, `visualization.rs:518`, `commands/template.rs:1237`, `commands/mod.rs:3627,3878`, `repository_state/mutation.rs:1452,1460,1942,1951`, `storage/repository_state_store_tests.rs:1703,1711`, `tests/fast_issue/transition_graph_enforcement_tests.rs:656` and `tests/fast_rules/example_rulesets_tests.rs:865`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `GateState` has a `last_run: Option<GateRunId>` field. A record without the field decodes with `None`, and `None` is not serialized, so an issue record whose gates were never run serializes to the same bytes as before.
- [hard] REQ-02: A gate state written in the same plan as a recorded run of that gate carries that run's id. Gate evaluation and lifecycle prechecks both produce it through `gate_state_from_run`.
- [hard] REQ-03: A gate status write that records no run keeps the gate's prior `last_run`, and a newly required gate starts with none.
- [hard] REQ-04: A unit test proves that evaluating a gate twice leaves `last_run` naming the second run, and a test proves that a manual status write leaves `last_run` unchanged.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the semantic-types epic (2195c98f): issue ids are `IssueId`, gate-run ids `GateRunId`, gate keys `GateKey`, lease ids `LeaseId`, events are an `Event` envelope around a tagged `EventBody`, and record paths come from `VirtualPath` constructors. Line citations name current code, which that epic retypes.

planning.outcome: Each recorded gate run's id is stored on the issue's gate state for that gate.

terminal.worker_sized_reason: One optional field, one producer function, and a mechanical literal sweep.

title: Gate captures hold only the evaluated issue's latest runs
description:
Make gate evaluation, precheck planning and validation's precheck-history capture request the evaluated issue's latest run of each gate by path, so the mutation image never holds another issue's runs.

## Background

A checker that consumes run history (`checker_consumes_run_history`, `crates/jit/src/commands/mod.rs:589-597`) receives the latest run of its gate on the evaluated issue (`compact_run_history_for_context`, `commands/gate_check.rs:252-266`). To find it, three captures list the whole `gate-runs/` root and take every run record into the image, then parse each one and keep those whose `issue_id` matches:

- gate evaluation: `discover_gate_run_results` (`commands/mod.rs:2048-2069`) called at `commands/gate_check.rs:806`, parsed by `captured_gate_runs` (`gate_check.rs:273-318`);
- precheck planning: `captured_precheck_plan` (`commands/mod.rs:622-680`, parse and filter at `:661-679`);
- validation's precheck-history capture: `commands/validate.rs:503-505`.

All three go through `captured_gate_run_result_paths` (`repository_state/mutation.rs:524-549`). The capture budget is 512 MB (`commands/mod.rs:235`), so the whole-root capture is also a future hard failure.

The issue record's gate state names the latest run of each gate (`GateState.last_run`), so the run record path is known from the issue record alone (`VirtualPath::gate_run_record`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Gate evaluation, precheck planning and validation's precheck-history capture request, for each history-consuming gate on the evaluated issue, only the run record that the issue's gate state names. None of them lists the `gate-runs/` root.
- [hard] REQ-02: `discover_gate_run_results` and `captured_gate_run_result_paths` no longer exist.
- [hard] REQ-03: A test shows that evaluating a history-consuming gate on one issue captures no run record of another issue, with other issues' runs present, and that the checker still receives the evaluated issue's latest run of that gate.
- [hard] REQ-04: A gate with no recorded latest run passes the checker an empty run history, and `compact_run_history_for_context` sanitizes the one captured run without selecting among runs.
